summary: Full-stack developer delivering client projects with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, Angular and SQL Server. Builds REST APIs, backend services and integrations with external systems such as Business Central and corporate e-procurement platforms, and Angular features for multi-tenant SaaS products. Designs AI-assisted development workflows with Claude Code, human review and automated tests.

bertoni-solutions.text: Built .NET backend services and Angular features for a multi-tenant digital credentials SaaS platform: Microsoft and Google OAuth login, organization and role management, the subscription and plan model, and report generation with reusable Angular components.

Built end to end a B2B operations platform pilot for an industrial distributor on .NET 10 and Angular 22, designed as a 12-module modular monolith with one SQL schema per module, delivering 18 requirements in 25 days.

Implemented integrations with Business Central and corporate e-procurement systems: cXML PunchOut with order audit, and API pages and queries in AL for prices, search, categories and checkout across 134 extension releases.
Built a .NET search microservice with ranking rules, autocomplete, client-certificate (mTLS) authentication, a standardized API response with centralized exception handling and output caching.

Added resilience pipelines with circuit breakers and timeouts on outbound integration clients, and instrumented Application Insights telemetry with availability tests, latency alerts and monitoring of scheduled tasks.
Built Azure DevOps pipelines with pull-request validation, QA/PROD approval gates and Bicep what-if checks, plus a Playwright E2E suite that runs after each deployment.

Designed and built Bertoni's corporate standard for AI-assisted software delivery: a Claude Code plugin with 13 skills, 9 subagents and governance hooks, with guardrails so no agent approves, merges or deploys.

freelance-ecommerce.text: Set up CI/CD with Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, Trivy image scanning, a database dump before each deploy, smoke tests and automatic rollback.
